slot: Your question, plus the daily report
summary: The S&P 500 fell 1.21% to 7,663.43 today, but the real pain was in tech. The Nasdaq 100 dropped 2.86% as investors worried that big AI companies are spending enormous sums on data centers without a clear payoff timeline. META fell nearly 7% after its earnings showed free cash flow turned negative, meaning it spent more than it brought in. Gold fell 2.84% and bitcoin dropped 3.26%, so there was no safe haven in alternative assets. Tomorrow brings Flash PMI readings, which measure how much business activity expanded or contracted this month.
